coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 8 ground-truth variable items (25%): child-to-parent versus parent-to-child query direction, and retrieval accuracy measured through correct answers and log-probabilities.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the IMDb top-1000/GPT-4-verified dataset with Wikidata-derived pairs and uses different models. Fixes temperature at zero instead of varying it by model/context. Question and cloze templates do not establish chat-based versus completion-based interaction modes. Does not specify the same dataset-creation, testing, and visualization scripts as a constant. Substitutes McNemar and mixed-effects analyses for the required t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to provide the expected conclusion that child-to-parent retrieval substantially outperforms parent-to-child retrieval, confirming the reversal curse in real-world knowledge.
